summary_claims.claim: Strategy adopts ethical principles as basis for responsible AI and says supervisory authorities should oversee AI systems in their areas (Summary p. 6; ch. 5.2).
Government will establish a data-protection regulatory sandbox under Datatilsynet.

scope.note: Mainly a data, skills and adoption strategy; safety content sits in chapter 5 (Trustworthy AI). The extractor's scope_note is adequate.

note: Official regjeringen.no pages and PDFs (English and Norwegian) confirm title, 14 Jan 2020 date and the original publisher. The new-strategy announcement of 5 Oct 2026 (press release, first half of 2027) is the only newer item and is a plan, not a strategy; the record stays current. The status quote is a date header rather than a status statement, but the press release says the strategy is still to be replaced, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' holds.
